notes: Routing checks for research: questions that need current outside facts must reach the MCP research tools (context7 for library docs, web-search to discover sources, grep for public code), and self-contained requests must not. Probes only count calls; read the transcripts to judge citations. Only skill:, mcp: and cmd: probes are used so every shipped profile can run these cases.
